 Penelope Cruz feared a scene would jeopardize her marriage
 The actress admitted that she was afraid of filming a heated argument with her husband Javier Bardem and that she was stressed for days.
 4166 views 0 comment(s) 
 Photo: Shutterstock 
 Disclaimer: The translations are mostly done through AI translator and might not be 100% accurate. 
 M 
 MV 
 15.11.2026. 07:40h 
 Penelope Cruz admitted that while filming the film "Bunker," in which she stars as a married couple with husband Javier Bardem, she feared that the intense and emotionally demanding scenes could affect their relationship in real life.
 The actress explained that she and Bardem try not to film together too often, and they usually only work on projects together every five or six years. As she pointed out, they both want to protect their marriage, as they believe that working together too often could be complicated and risky.
 However, they did not want to turn down director Florian Zeler's offer, even though one scene was particularly difficult for them. It involved a major argument between their characters, which was filmed over three days and required them to deal with very unpleasant emotions.
 "It was scary for me because we had to go into situations that were really uncomfortable. Even when it's not your real story, you know you're touching on something very sensitive. I was more scared of the seven-day period before filming than the scene itself. I was so burdened by it that it became a real nightmare," Cruz said.
 She added that Zeler's approach made filming easier for her, and in the end they were able to enjoy even that demanding scene. The actress emphasized that they felt his support and understanding throughout the entire process.
